title: Allowance Schedule — The Channel Allowance on a Returned Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Allowance Schedule — The Channel Allowance on a Returned Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The channel the payment arrived on decides the channel allowance the finance desk grants against the charge for a payment sent back unpaid on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan.

| The returned payment | The channel allowance |
|---|---|
| Came in on a channel the term credits on the day it is received, and it is the only payment sent back on the plan in the whole month ending on the handling date | **6.00 USD** |
| Came in by posted cheque, and it is the only payment sent back on the plan in the whole month ending on the handling date | **3.00 USD** |
| Any other return | No channel allowance is granted |

Each of the first two rows needs both of its conditions. Where two or more payments have been sent back on the plan in the whole month ending on the handling date, no channel allowance is granted whatever channel the return came in on.

## The channels each term credits on the day of receipt

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Channels credited the same day when received before the cut-off | in store, online portal | in store, online portal | in store, online portal | in store, online portal, phone agent | in store, online portal, phone agent | in store, online portal, phone agent, automatic payment |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A single payment sent back unpaid in the month, taken at a store counter, on a plan written on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan: an in-store payment is one that term credits on the day it is received, so the channel allowance is 6.00 USD. The same single return taken by a phone agent on a plan written on the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan falls in the third row, that term crediting in store and online portal payments on the day of receipt and not payments taken by a phone agent, so no channel allowance is granted. A payment that arrived by posted cheque, alone in its month, draws 3.00 USD on any term.
